description: Performance budgets for playwright-archaeologist. All times in milliseconds, memory in megabytes, sizes in kilobytes. Bench names must include the first 8 characters of a key (case-insensitive) for enforce-budget.test.ts to match them — see enforce-budget.test.ts for the matching logic.

timeToProcess10Pages.notes: Simulated with mock browser (no real network). Measures orchestrator + frontier + collector overhead only. Not measured by the current bench suite — tracked here for documentation.

timeToProcess100Pages.notes: With concurrency=3, mock browser. ~300ms per page budget including all collector passes. Not measured by the current bench suite.

timeToProcess500Pages.notes: With concurrency=3, mock browser. Context recycling every 50 pages. Not measured by the current bench suite.

enqueue10000Urls.notes: Includes URL normalization and dedup check per enqueue. Matches bench `enqueue 10000 URLs through Frontier`.

dequeue10000Urls.notes: Dequeue-until-empty over a pre-filled frontier. Matches bench `dequeue 10000 URLs from a pre-filled Frontier`.

urlNormalization.notes: 10000 calls with varied URL shapes; memoization cache cleared per iteration. Matches bench `urlNormalization: 10000 calls ...`.

htmlGeneration100Pages.notes: generateReportHtml over a 100-page synthetic ReportInput. Matches bench `htmlGeneration100Pages`.

htmlGeneration1000Pages.notes: generateReportHtml over a 1000-page synthetic ReportInput. Matches bench `htmlGeneration1000Pages`.

htmlGeneration10000Pages.notes: generateReportHtml over a 10000-page synthetic ReportInput. Primarily a ceiling to detect quadratic regressions — the real tool rarely sees this many pages. Matches bench `htmlGeneration10000Pages`.

diffReportGeneration.notes: generateDiffReportHtml over a synthetic DiffResult (30 added / 10 removed / 50 changed routes). Matches bench `diffReportGeneration`.

pixelDiff100x100.notes: diffScreenshotPair over a 100x100 PNG pair with a 1% patch, no heatmap emitted. Matches bench `pixelDiff100x100`.

pixelDiff1000x1000.notes: diffScreenshotPair over a 1000x1000 PNG pair with a 1% patch and heatmap emit. PNG decode + pixelmatch + PNG encode dominate. Matches bench `pixelDiff1000x1000`.

diffTotal100Pages.notes: diffBundles end-to-end: write two 100-route bundles to tmp, then run the full diff pipeline. Matches bench `diffTotal100Pages`.

diffTotal500Pages.notes: diffBundles end-to-end on 500-route synthetic bundles. Matches bench `diffTotal500Pages`.

routeTreeWith1000Urls.notes: buildRouteTree over 1000 PageVisitResults with varying depth (2-7 segments). Matches bench `routeTreeWith1000Urls`.

buildAssembledArtifacts500Pages.notes: Full assembler pipeline (route tree + routes + API endpoints + flow graph + screenshot manifest) over a synthetic 500-page CrawlResult. Matches bench `buildAssembledArtifacts over 500 synthetic PageVisitResults`.

rssWarningThreshold.notes: Log warning when RSS exceeds this. Triggers reduced concurrency. Not enforced by the bench suite — consumed by the runtime orchestrator.

rssPauseThreshold.notes: Pause new context creation when RSS exceeds this. Wait for contexts to close. Not enforced by the bench suite.
